title: Replace chaotic gradient colors with standard Shadcn semantic colors
body:
The playground had chaotic color schemes throughout, with purple/indigo/pink gradients applied to buttons, backgrounds, text, and decorative elements. This deviated from the standard Shadcn/UI design system and created visual noise.

## Changes

- **`apps/playground/src/index.css`**: Removed 5 chart color CSS variables from both light and dark themes
- **`apps/playground/tailwind.config.js`**: Removed chart color definitions from Tailwind config
- **`apps/playground/src/pages/Home.tsx`**: Replaced all gradient colors with semantic Shadcn color tokens
- **`apps/playground/src/pages/MyDesigns.tsx`**: Replaced all gradient colors with semantic Shadcn color tokens
- **`apps/playground/src/pages/Studio.tsx`**: Replaced all gradient colors with semantic Shadcn color tokens

### Color Replacements

- `bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600` → `bg-primary text-primary-foreground`
- `bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-pink-600` → `bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground`
- `text-indigo-600` → `text-primary`
- `bg-indigo-50` → `bg-muted`
- `text-gray-500` → `text-muted-foreground`
- Removed all colored shadows (`shadow-indigo-300/50`, etc.)
- Replaced decorative gradient backgrounds with semantic colors

## Visual Impact

**Before**: Chaotic purple/indigo/pink gradients everywhere
![Before](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c30cdf93-62ad-4d07-9c34-298423eebb71)

**After**: Clean, professional Shadcn semantic colors
![After](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/66e7d5af-ca75-496c-9667-bb538165d7d1)

**Studio Interface:**
![Studio](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/20bdee91-34f6-4939-a80d-febd08f42473)

**My Designs Page:**
![My Designs](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1e3602d5-bd86-40e9-b715-e06848d448c8)

## Benefits

✅ Cleaner, more professional appearance  
✅ Consistent with standard Shadcn/UI design system  
✅ Better maintainability - colors are now theme-aware  
✅ Improved accessibility - standard contrast ratios  
✅ No breaking changes - all functionality intact
